summary: `bynk deploy` refused to put a context that hosts agents on a different Worker script than it was last deployed to (into or out of a `[deploy.workers.<key>]` group, between groups, or after a group is renamed or re-keyed): an agent's state belongs to its script, so it would start empty and the old data would stay behind. Start it fresh deliberately with `--accept-fresh-agent <context>`, which a move out of a group that stays cannot use.
